description: This file is a shell script for automated testing of Git checkout behavior under various scenarios, including handling untracked files, directories, symlinks, and ignore rules.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to succeed, with a descriptive label.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that the preceding command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_ln_s_add
methods.description: Creates a symbolic link and adds it to the Git index.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Verifies that a specified path is a file.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
